## graph sweep covers registered checkouts

ID: `graph-checkout-refresh/graph-sweep-covers-registered-checkouts`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`--all-graph` SHALL refresh every shared checkout registered in the graph under $HOME, except checkouts (and repositories nested in them) that a baseline file marks as operated on in place.

Implemented by:

- `refresh_canonical_checkouts` — [`scripts/refresh_canonical_checkouts.py:1`](../../scripts/refresh_canonical_checkouts.py#L1)

- Scenario `graph-sweep-covers-registered-checkouts`: tested by `tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py::test_graph_targets_lists_registered_checkouts_and_skips_in_place_mirrors` ([`tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py:794`](../../tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py#L794)), `tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py::test_all_graph_refreshes_unlisted_checkout_without_touching_the_stamp` ([`tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py:817`](../../tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py#L817))

## never discards local work

ID: `graph-checkout-refresh/never-discards-local-work`

Status: **implemented and tested**

The refresh SHALL NOT reset, stash, discard or advance a checkout that is dirty, off its default branch, ahead of or diverged from upstream, or holding a lock receipt, and SHALL report each as non-canonical.

## settings come from config

ID: `graph-checkout-refresh/settings-come-from-config`

Status: **implemented and tested**

The concern repository SHALL come from `CONCERN_REPO` or `concern_repo` in `graph-config.yaml` beside the graph, and a missing value SHALL stop the run naming where to set it.

Implemented by:

- `refresh_canonical_checkouts` — [`scripts/refresh_canonical_checkouts.py:1`](../../scripts/refresh_canonical_checkouts.py#L1)

- Scenario `settings-come-from-config`: tested by `tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py::test_missing_concern_repo_stops_loudly_naming_where_to_set_it` ([`tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py:929`](../../tests/test_refresh_canonical_checkouts.py#L929))

## stuck checkouts raise a concern

ID: `graph-checkout-refresh/stuck-checkouts-raise-a-concern`

Status: **implemented and tested**

Checkouts left alone while at least the threshold behind SHALL open one keyed concern naming each; when none remain the concern SHALL be closed; a failure to route it SHALL fail the run.

Implemented by:

- `refresh_canonical_checkouts` — [`scripts/refresh_canonical_checkouts.py:1`](../../scripts/refresh_canonical_checkouts.py#L1)
